name: BA Assist Healthcare Payer Ontology
description: Canonical model for STTM generation: the enterprise Payer Data Dictionary (status 'approved') plus a draft Payment Integrity extension (status 'proposed'). See ontology.md.

statusLegend.approved: Copied from the Payer Data Dictionary as-is (names trimmed).
statusLegend.proposed: Draft from ontology.md section 6. Must be approved by Payment Integrity SMEs and the data architect before use as a confirmed target.

valueSets.name: Dependent Sequence

rules.description: Corrected paid amount equals paid amount minus identified overpayment.
rules.expression: PI Opportunity.Corrected_Paid_Amount = Claim Header.Total_Paid_Amount - PI Opportunity.Identified_Overpayment_Amount
rules.evidence: Holds in 30 of 30 rows of Input.xlsx (synthetic).

rules.description: Identified overpayment cannot exceed the amount paid.
rules.evidence: Holds in 30 of 30 rows of Input.xlsx (synthetic).

rules.description: Member ID is built from the last 5 digits of Subscriber ID and the dependent sequence.
rules.evidence: Holds in 30 of 30 rows of Input.xlsx (synthetic); confirm it is a real rule.

rules.description: One NPI always resolves to one provider name.
rules.evidence: Holds for 9 of 9 providers in Input.xlsx.

rules.description: An opportunity's audit type should match its concept's default audit type.
rules.evidence: Pairings vary in the sample (e.g. DRG Validation with Prior Authorization Not Found); SMEs to define the mapping.
